SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ, STATUS, DECODE(STATUS,'C',TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MI'),GR_TIME) AS ADD_TIME, IF_FLAG FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'WINC') AND IF_FLAG IN ('N','E') AND NOT (TRIM(KEY_3) IS NULL OR TRIM(KEY_9) IS NULL OR TRIM(ADD_USER_ID) IS NULL OR (STATUS = 'D' AND GR_TIME IS NULL) ) AND ROWNUM = 1 ORDER BY IF_FLAG DESC , BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ, STATUS
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER, A.GR_NO AS KEP_GR_NO, A.GR_SEQ AS KEP_GR_SEQ, B.PO_NO AS KEP_PO_NO, B.PO_SEQ AS KEP_PO_SEQ, A.STATUS, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, B.DESCRIPTION, B.SPECIFICATION, A.GR_DATE AS ADD_DATE, '$G_RS.ADD_TIME$' AS ADD_TIME, A.ADD_USER_ID, A.GR_DATE, A.GR_QTY AS ITP_QTY, A.UNIT_PRICE AS ITP_UNIT_PRICE, A.GR_AMT AS ITP_PRICE, A.KEY_1 AS ITP_FAC_CODE, A.KEY_9 AS ITP_ITE_CODE, 'D000' AS ITP_COL_CODE, A.KEY_10 AS ITP_LENGTH, A.KEY_5 AS ITP_VEND_CODE, A.KEY_7 AS ITP_SPOT_CODE, A.KEY_8 AS ITP_SPOT_NAME, A.KEY_3 AS ITP_BUY_CODE, A.KEY_4 AS ITP_LOCATION FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND A , ICOMPODT B , ICOMGRDT C WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND A.GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.GR_NO = C.GR_NO AND A.GR_SEQ = C.GR_SEQ AND C.BUYER = B.BUYER AND C.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND C.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE , GR_TIME = '$G_RS.ADD_TIME$' WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$'
